tray.background: Transfers continue in the notification area. Choose Exit from the TinyTorrent menu to stop.

error.source: The torrent could not be added.
error.ownership: TinyTorrent cannot open its saved data. Another Windows logon may already be using this folder:
error.launch: TinyTorrent could not start its window. Downloads continue. Retry to open it again.
error.startup: The TinyTorrent window did not open. Downloads continue. Retry is available after the window process exits.
error.save: The final checkpoint could not be saved. Retry, or exit anyway and lose changes since the last successful save.
error.pause: The transfer pause setting could not be saved.
error.unresponsive: The window is not responding. Exit anyway and discard unfinished input?
